description: Comparing N-terminal targeting features of AIM33 with reductases of known localization (Mcr1 mitochondrial, Cbr1 ER, PGA3 plasma membrane)
code:
# N-terminal targeting features of AIM33 against yeast reductases with known localization:
# Mcr1 (mitochondrial OM + IMS, bipartite signal in residues 1-47, PMID 9199337),
# Cbr1 (ER/microsomal), PGA3/NQR1 (plasma membrane), AIM33 and the AIM33 ohnolog partner.
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

KD = dict(zip("AVLIPFMWGSTCYNQDEKRH",
              [1.8,4.2,3.8,4.5,-1.6,2.8,1.9,-0.9,-0.4,-0.8,-0.7,2.5,-1.3,-3.5,-3.5,-3.5,-3.5,-3.9,-4.5,-3.2]))
def fetch(ac):
    r = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{ac}.fasta", timeout=60); r.raise_for_status()
    return "".join(r.text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()

prots = {"AIM33 (Q04516)": "Q04516", "PGA3/NQR1 (Q12746)": "Q12746",
         "Mcr1 (P36060)": "P36060", "Cbr1 (P38626)": "P38626", "hCYB5R3 (P00387)": "P00387"}
seq = {k: fetch(v) for k, v in prots.items()}

def netq(s):   # Lys+Arg minus Asp+Glu
    return sum(s.count(c) for c in "KR") - sum(s.count(c) for c in "DE")
def maxkd(s, w=19):
    if len(s) < w: return np.nan
    v = np.array([KD[c] for c in s if c in KD])
    return max(v[i:i+w].mean() for i in range(len(v)-w+1))
def hyd_moment(s, w=18, delta=100.0):   # max alpha-helical hydrophobic moment
    v = np.array([KD.get(c, 0.0) for c in s]); best = 0.0
    ang = np.deg2rad(delta)*np.arange(w)
    for i in range(max(1, len(v)-w+1)):
        seg = v[i:i+w]
        if len(seg) < w: break
        best = max(best, np.hypot((seg*np.cos(ang)).sum(), (seg*np.sin(ang)).sum())/w)
    return best

print(f"{'protein':22s} {'len':>4s} {'q(1-30)':>8s} {'q(1-50)':>8s} {'maxKD(1-75)':>12s} {'muH(1-40)':>10s} {'Ser+Arg%(1-30)':>15s}")
rows = []
for k, s in seq.items():
    n30, n50 = s[:30], s[:50]
    sr = 100*sum(n30.count(c) for c in "SR")/30
    row = (k, len(s), netq(n30), netq(n50), maxkd(s[:75]), hyd_moment(s[:40]), sr)
    rows.append(row)
    print(f"{k:22s} {len(s):4d} {netq(n30):8d} {netq(n50):8d} {maxkd(s[:75]):12.2f} {hyd_moment(s[:40]):10.2f} {sr:15.1f}")

print("\nN-terminal 50 residues:")
for k, s in seq.items():
    print(f"  {k:22s} {s[:50]}")

# per-residue KD profile over the first 90 residues
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(10, 7), sharex=True,
                         gridspec_kw={"height_ratios": [2, 1.1]})
cols = {"AIM33 (Q04516)": "#c00000", "PGA3/NQR1 (Q12746)": "#1f4e79",
        "Mcr1 (P36060)": "#2e7d32", "Cbr1 (P38626)": "#7b5ea7", "hCYB5R3 (P00387)": "#999999"}
W = 11
for k, s in seq.items():
    v = np.array([KD.get(c, 0.0) for c in s[:95]])
    sm = np.convolve(v, np.ones(W)/W, mode="valid")
    axes[0].plot(np.arange(len(sm)) + W//2 + 1, sm, color=cols[k], lw=1.9, label=k)
axes[0].axhline(1.6, color="k", ls=":", lw=1)
axes[0].text(88, 1.72, "membrane-anchor threshold 1.6", ha="right", fontsize=8)
axes[0].set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle, 11-residue window")
axes[0].legend(fontsize=8, loc="upper left"); axes[0].set_xlim(1, 90)
axes[0].set_title("AIM33 and PGA3 both begin with a hydrophobic anchor; Mcr1 begins with a\npositively charged matrix-targeting segment before its anchor", fontsize=10)

for k, s in seq.items():
    q = np.cumsum([1 if c in "KR" else (-1 if c in "DE" else 0) for c in s[:90]])
    axes[1].plot(np.arange(1, len(q)+1), q, color=cols[k], lw=1.9)
axes[1].axhline(0, color="k", lw=.8)
axes[1].set_ylabel("cumulative net charge"); axes[1].set_xlabel("residue")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
